Before broad TutorChat rollout for an Enterprise customer, NovaLearn should take the following evidence-backed steps:

1. **Complete SSO and permission audits first**. Enterprise accounts that have not yet deployed TutorChat broadly are running limited pilots pending these audits; once SSO and permission audits are complete, TutorChat adoption is expected to scale rapidly `[NL-030#NL-030-S03]`. This maps to the enterprise onboarding complexity (median 8.7 weeks) driven by permission and security requirements `[NL-016#NL-016-S03]`.

2. **Resolve permission mapping friction**. Enterprise and mid-market customers report onboarding delays from the complexity of mapping nested permissions from source repositories (e.g., SharePoint, local file servers) to NovaLearn workspaces `[NL-011#NL-011-S01]`. SSO is GA for Enterprise via Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, and OneLogin (SAML/OIDC), and access tokens must be mapped to document folder permissions `[NL-002#NL-002-S03]` `[NL-002#NL-002-S11]`, so these mappings must be validated before scaling to thousands of users.

3. **Run a pilot with 100–300 users in high-impact departments** rather than a very small team. Although sales discussions favor small agile teams, official business metrics (SMB churn 4.8%, Enterprise NPS 52) indicate that for mid-market and enterprise clients, pilots should target 100–300 users in high-impact departments to justify onboarding investment `[NL-023#NL-023-S03]`.

4. **Assign a dedicated customer success resource** to help structure KnowledgeHub ingestion and manage document cleanup, as recommended in the sales call for messy enterprise file sources (legacy PDFs, DOCX, etc.) `[NL-023#NL-023-S03]`.

5. **Clarify the Microsoft Teams integration status before rollout**. Teams integration is not generally available; it is in design and planning for Q4 2026 (with a restricted pilot in October 2026), contrary to informal sales/Slack chatter suggesting it is "almost ready" `[NL-014#NL-014-S07]`. Current collaboration integrations are limited to Slack (limited pilot) `[NL-002#NL-002-S11]`. Since several enterprise renewals depend on the Teams connector `[NL-011#NL-011-S01]`, NovaLearn must explicitly communicate this availability and timeline to the customer or plan for Slack/web-based adoption initially.

6. **Validate API scalability and rate limits for the broader user base**. Enterprise custom frontends using the TutorChat API are capped at 150 requests per minute per tenant, with a Retry-After header for 429s; large batch queries should distribute workloads or use exponential backoff, and clients are encouraged to cache frequent responses for up to 10 minutes `[NL-002#NL-002-S11]`. This must be planned to prevent service denial when user volume scales from a pilot to full workforce.
